objective: The viewer sees Sudair City as a place full of people and decides to follow the month to meet them.
hero_en: Message: Sudair City is a place with people in it. Cover frame in the key-visual petal style: dark emerald left side for the headline, three tall glowing petal windows in a fan above the real campus at golden hour with palms and warm walkway lights; inside the petals a drone view of the site, steady hands at a bench and a team standing together. Calm, cinematic, no product, no readable label, logo area top-left kept clear.
generated_elements: Petal-window composite and colour grade for the cover frame only; every shot of the reel is real footage.
compliance_note: People at work only; no process explained, no figures, no assurance wording; frame A013 to faces and hands so no pack or label reads.
sub_en: Told by the people who live it
caption_ar:
يبدأ يومنا في مدينة سدير مع ضوء الصباح، ويمتد بين وجوهٍ وأيدٍ وأماكن نعرفها جيدًا.
نصحبكم اليوم في جولة قصيرة من الجو إلى الوجوه.
تابعونا طوال الشهر لنتعمّق أكثر في الناس والمكان.
caption_en:
Our day begins in Sudair City with the morning light and moves through faces, hands and places we know well.
Come along on a short tour, from the sky down to the faces.
Stay with us this month as we go deeper into the people and the place.
concept: One walk from the drone view down to the faces: where Sudair City is, and who is in it. No explanation of what is made, only where and by whom.
audio: Warm, light instrumental with a slow pulse around 90 bpm, soft room tone under the interior shots, a gentle chime on each cut, no vocals, no named tracks.
vo_ar: يبدأ يومنا مع ضوء الصباح. مكانٌ واسع في قلب نجد، وفيه وجوهٌ تعرفه جيدًا. أيدٌ هادئة عند الطاولة، وفريقٌ يقف معًا. هذه مدينتنا، وهؤلاء أهلها. صناعة تُرى، وأثر يُقاس.
vo_en: Our day begins with the morning light. A wide place in the heart of Najd, and inside it, faces that know it well. Quiet hands at the bench, a team standing together. This is our city, and these are its people. Visible capability. Measurable impact.
cover_hero_en: Petal-window cover over the campus at golden hour, headline in the dark emerald left column, logo area clear.
